definitions.ranking: Unique documents in first-occurrence order among ranked chunks; k counts documents.
definitions.ndcg: Gain=2**grade-1; discount=log2(rank+1); ideal uses every judged document for the question.
definitions.recall_ge1: Grades 1 and 2 count as relevant; denominator is all such judged documents.
definitions.recall_ge2: Only grade 2 counts as relevant; denominator is all grade-2 judged documents.
definitions.precision: Relevant documents in first k divided by k, even when fewer than k were returned.
definitions.macro: Mean over input questions with a defined denominator; excluded questions have null scores.
definitions.chunk_coverage: Document recall inside the first k chunks, with duplicate documents counted once.
definitions.limitations: Estimated document relevance does not measure chunk usefulness or final answer correctness.
